messages.docs:
Variant 0. At the holder's own actor, as a top-level call or the root of a private
execution: debit one denomination (from its own state, or else from `holder(cid, account)`, to
which it forwards the note) and send the note to `token(cid, token)`, which admits it (the
denomination, the burn freezes and caps) and records it once at `burn(cid, r)`: a second note with a used tag
is refused.
messages.name: Burn

messages.docs:
Variant 1. At `config(cid)`: attest the vault's slots 0 and 1 under the record at
`record_slot` and write `root(cid, leaf_count)` if they hold `root` and `leaf_count`.
Refused after `Sunset`.
messages.name: ImportRoot

messages.docs:
Variant 2. The configuration's one-way `Sunset`: a top-level call (or private root) at the
freeze authority's own actor, forwarded to `config(cid)`; stops `ImportRoot` for good.
messages.name: Sunset

messages.docs: Variant 3. Rule (A)'s echo nonce: accepted anywhere, changes nothing.
messages.name: Echo

messages.docs:
Variant 4. At `config(cid)`, `cid` computed from `config`: attest the vault's slot 2 and
write the configuration if it holds `cid` (the reciprocal pairing, B5).
messages.name: Init

messages.docs:
Variant 5. At `root(cid, n)`: the plaintext claim, for a public destination. `relayer`
receives the relay fee (`None`: the fee recipient). It carries no time: the token's and the
configuration's attested clocks apply.
messages.name: Claim

messages.docs:
Variant 6. At the claimant's own actor, meant to run privately: read `root(cid, n)`, verify
the claim inside this execution, then `Issue`; a private destination must be this account.
messages.name: ClaimPrivately

messages.docs: Variant 7. Reply with this actor's state (`StateReply`), LEZ v0.4's read idiom.
messages.name: Read

messages.docs: Variant 8. `config(cid)` → `root(cid, n)`: the verified root, written once.
messages.name: WriteRoot

messages.docs:
Variant 9. `token(cid, token)` → `nullifier(cid, chain, vault, N)`: spend `N` once; mint the
denomination to `mint_to` (a public account) if given, and each fee to its account.
messages.name: Spend

messages.docs: Variant 10. `nullifier(cid, chain, vault, N)` → `holder(cid, holder)`: credit `amount` of `token`.
messages.name: Mint

messages.docs:
Variant 11. At `config(cid)`: attest the vault's registry entry of `entry.token`, its fee
schedules 0 and 1 and its leaf count under one record, and write `token(cid, token)`.
messages.name: Register

messages.docs:
Variant 12. At `config(cid)`: attest the vault's fee schedule `index` of `token` (its hash,
or zero if `schedule` is `None`) and its leaf count, and extend `token(cid, token)`.
messages.name: ImportFees

messages.docs: Variant 13. `config(cid)` → `token(cid, token)`: the attested entry, written once.
messages.name: WriteToken

messages.docs:
Variant 14. `config(cid)` → `token(cid, token)`: an attested fee schedule (appended), or
the attested absence of schedule `index` at a leaf count (the schedules cover up to it).
messages.name: ExtendFees

messages.docs:
Variant 15. A claimant (the root of a plaintext claim, or a private claimant) →
`token(cid, token)` after verifying the deposit: the denomination, its fixed relay fee, the
mint freezes and caps; then `Admit` to `config(cid)` and `Spend`. No schedule field is
present, so the public boundary does not reveal when the deposit was made.
messages.name: Issue

messages.docs:
Variant 16. `token(cid, token)` → `config(cid)`: the global freeze and bucket of a mint or a
burn of `value` units, at the configuration's attested time.
messages.name: Admit

messages.docs:
Variant 17. The freeze authority, like `Sunset`: freeze mints and/or burns of `token` (or of
the whole configuration) until `until_ms` (0 unfreezes). The target first reads `record`
(as `Tick` does); `until_ms` must lie after that attested time and at most 30 days after it.
messages.name: Freeze

messages.docs:
Variant 18. The admin, like `Sunset`: set the mint (or burn) bucket of `token` (or the
global one), never below the floor; refilled at the target's attested time first.
messages.name: SetCap

messages.docs:
Variant 19. Anyone, at `config(cid)` or `token(cid, token)`: read the attestation
program's `record` and advance the target's clock to its execution timestamp; the
transaction is valid only in a block stamped at or after that time.
messages.name: Tick

messages.docs:
Anyone, at `config(cid)`: attest the vault's `retired` flag ([`SLOT_RETIRED`]) under the
record at `record_slot`. The vault sets it only by `retire()`, which anyone may call after
D13's 30 days without checkpoint progress; afterwards anyone may send `Sunset` at
`config(cid)` (keyless retirement).
messages.name: AttestRetired

messages.docs:
The admin, at its own actor, then `config(cid)`: propose a new freeze authority and watcher
set, applicable [`ROLE_TIMELOCK_MS`] after the attested time of `record` (read first, in a
block stamped at most [`PROPOSAL_RECORD_AGE_MS`] after it). Replaces a pending proposal.
messages.name: ProposeRoles

messages.docs:
Anyone, at `config(cid)`: read `record`, then apply the proposal if that time is at least
its `effective_ms` (the vault's `applyRoles`).
messages.name: ApplyRoles

messages.docs: The admin, at its own actor, then `config(cid)`: withdraw the pending proposal.
messages.name: CancelRoles

messages.docs:
A watcher, at its own actor, then `config(cid)` (and `token(cid, token)`): read `record`,
then pause mints and/or burns for 12 hours of attested time.
messages.name: Pause

messages.docs:
`signers`, members of a multisig freeze authority, in one transaction each of them signed:
a top-level call at the first one's own actor, forwarded along their own actors, each
checking its own signature, then to `config(cid)`, which checks the threshold.
messages.name: Cosigned

messages.docs:
A holder, at its own actor (a call it authorised): move `amount` of its claimed balance
(its own state first, else `holder(cid, account)`) through `token(cid, token)` (a multiple of
the token's LEZ unit) to `holder(to)`. From a private account, only the boundary delivery
to the token is public: not the sender.
messages.name: Transfer

messages.docs:
`token(cid, token)` → `holder(cid, to)` only: credit a transfer, or the protocol fees `MintFees` mints to the
fee recipient (ADR 0048).
messages.name: Credit

messages.docs:
Variant 28. The admin, like `SetCap`: the inbound finality depth beyond Ethereum finality, in beacon slots
(at most [`MAX_INBOUND_DEPTH_SLOTS`]; [`Roles::inbound_depth_slots`]). Applies to imports from then on.
messages.name: SetDepth

messages.docs:
Variant 29. Anyone, at `config(cid)`: attest the vault's [`listing_slot`] of `token` under the record at
`record_slot`, then `SetListing` at `token(cid, token)` (F.10: the LEZ registry follows the vault's delisting
and relisting).
messages.name: AttestListing

messages.docs:
Variant 30. `config(cid)` → `token(cid, token)` only: the attested listing, kept if its record is newer than
the one the token holds.
messages.name: SetListing

messages.docs:
Variant 31 (ADR 0048). Anyone, at `config(cid)`: attest the vault's [`lez_fees_slot`] of `token` (the protocol
fees it has escrowed for the fee recipient on LEZ) under the record at `record_slot`, then `AccrueFees` at
`fees(cid, token)`, which mints at most `limit` of what is not minted yet to the fee recipient. No user's
transaction is involved: the amount is a total over every deposit and release up to that record.
messages.name: CollectFees

messages.docs:
Variant 32. `config(cid)` → `fees(cid, token)` only: the attested total (a 256-bit big-endian word, as the vault
holds it); `fees(cid, token)` keeps the new count and sends `MintFees` for the difference (at most `limit`).
messages.name: AccrueFees

messages.docs:
Variant 33. `fees(cid, token)` → `token(cid, token)` only: mint `amount` (a multiple of the LEZ unit) to the
configuration's fee recipient, through the token's and the configuration's mint freezes and buckets.
messages.name: MintFees

fields.docs:
The bridge program's image id, as the vault's verifier pins it. The program cannot see its
own image id; it is part of `configId`, which the vault pins.
fields.name: bridge_image_id

fields.docs: The attestation program whose records the configuration reads Ethereum through.
fields.name: attestation

fields.docs: The attestation instance those records belong to.
fields.name: instance_id

fields.docs: Available at `last_ms`.
fields.name: level

fields.docs: `uint256`, big-endian.
fields.name: amount

fields.docs: The 32 siblings, leaf level first.
fields.name: path

fields.docs: `0x01` private, `0x02` public (SPEC-v2 §3.3).
fields.name: kind

fields.docs: Sets caps, never below `floor`; cannot freeze or unfreeze.
fields.name: admin

fields.docs: Freezes mints and burns (≤ 30 days unless renewed) and runs `Sunset`.
fields.name: freeze_authority

fields.docs:
Receives, on LEZ, the protocol fees `CollectFees` mints (ADR 0048: the vault's mint and burn fees, in the
wrapped token) and the relay fee of a claim that names no relayer.
fields.name: fee_recipient

fields.docs: The immutable floor of every cap.
fields.name: floor

fields.docs: The caps a token starts with at registration, and the global caps.
fields.name: token_cap

fields.docs: Ethereum seconds: when the admin announced it, and when it took effect.
fields.name: announced_at

fields.docs:
Paid at deposit on top of the denomination; the vault escrows it and adds it to [`lez_fees_slot`] (ADR 0048),
minted on LEZ to the fee recipient by `CollectFees`. Never read by a claim.
fields.name: mint_fees

fields.docs:
Deducted from a release on Ethereum under the schedule in force then; the vault escrows it and adds it to
[`lez_fees_slot`] (ADR 0048). Never read by a burn.
fields.name: burn_fees

fields.docs: Mints (claims) or burns are refused while `now_ms < *_until`; 0: not frozen.
fields.name: mints_until

fields.docs: A private claim between its `Read` and the reply (within one transaction).
fields.name: pending

fields.docs:
In the token's base units: a sum of whole denominations for users; the fee recipient and
relayers also hold fees.
fields.name: amount

fields.docs: `uint256`, big-endian.
fields.name: amount

fields.docs: The leaf count of the root the claim read.
fields.name: leaf_count

fields.docs: Up to three; each may pause mints or burns for 12 hours. None until a handover sets them.
fields.name: watchers

fields.docs: The vault's `retired` flag was attested (`AttestRetired`): anyone may send `Sunset`.
fields.name: vault_retired

fields.docs: The freeze authority approved `Sunset` by `Cosigned`; anyone may then send it.
fields.name: sunset_approved

fields.docs:
The inbound finality depth beyond Ethereum finality, in beacon slots (F.12): `ImportRoot` under the record at
slot `s` is refused (`FROZEN`) until the configuration's clock has read a record at slot `s + depth` or later.
0 at `Init` (Ethereum finality: every record is of a finalized header), at most
[`MAX_INBOUND_DEPTH_SLOTS`]; set by the admin (`SetDepth`), for imports from then on only.
fields.name: inbound_depth_slots

fields.docs:
The newest record slot the configuration's clock has read (`Tick`, `Freeze`, `Pause`, `ProposeRoles`,
`ApplyRoles` at `config(cid)`): the finalized tip that [`Roles::inbound_depth_slots`] is measured against.
fields.name: tip_slot

fields.docs: The beacon slot of the record the root was attested under, and its execution block.
fields.name: record_slot

fields.docs:
The wrapped token's definition account on LEZ (zero in the M0 fallback: the bridge keeps
the balances itself, `lez/BRIDGE.md` §3).
fields.name: lez_definition

fields.docs: The token's decimals on Ethereum.
fields.name: decimals

fields.docs:
Base units per LEZ unit: a power of ten (the v0.4 token program has no decimals field, so
the registry holds the conversion).
fields.name: lez_unit

fields.docs: Global-cap value units per LEZ unit (the vault's `unitWeight`).
fields.name: unit_weight

fields.docs: 1 to 8, strictly increasing, each an exact multiple of `lez_unit`.
fields.name: denominations

fields.docs: One per denomination, fixed at registration, each at most 1% of it.
fields.name: relay_fees

fields.docs:
The attestation program and instance the configuration reads Ethereum through (copied at
registration): the token's clock reads their records.
fields.name: attestation

fields.docs: By index; `from_leaf` non-decreasing.
fields.name: schedules

fields.docs: Every leaf index below this falls under a known schedule.
fields.name: known_until

fields.docs: The configuration's roles and floor (copied at registration; immutable).
fields.name: controls

fields.docs:
A `Read` of a record for the gate's clock, outstanding within one transaction (`None`
between transactions).
fields.name: pending

fields.docs:
The vault refuses deposits of the token (delisted), as attested under the record at `listing_slot` (F.10).
Claims of its deposits, its burns and its transfers are not affected: delisting stops new deposits only, on
the vault, and no valid claim or burn is invalidated by it (R.4).
fields.name: delisted

fields.docs: The record slot of the newest listing attested (the registration's record at first).
fields.name: listing_slot
